text:
mina: Heads-up — PMs want a "rehearsal" action in Console for saved queries: run a quick sampled playback of recent traffic to show model splits, estimated token cost, and a small regression diff (current vs candidate) before saving/rollout. Thoughts?
rick: Love the idea. Key constraints: must not increment billing or mutate caches. We need a synthetic flag in logs so downstream systems ignore these runs.
sophie: Agreed. Default scope should be "me" and route/org scope must be explicit and permission-checked. Also redact fallback reasons and internal pool names.
devon: API sketch (very rough):
```
POST /api/console/rehearse 
{
  "query": "...",
  "scope": "me|route|org",
  "window": "1h|6h",
  "sample_pct": 1|5|10,
  "candidate_model": "optional-model-id"
}
-> 200
{
  "rehearsal_id": "reh_123",
  "est_tokens": 1200,
  "est_cost_cents": 15,
  "latency_p50_ms": 180,
  "model_split": [{"model": "rwd-7b-q", "pct": 0.72}],
  "regression_summary": ["latency down", "small increase in refusal rate"]
}
```
This reuses the eval harness but must run in sandbox mode and never touch billing hooks.
han: Telemetry note: mark replay events with meta.rehearsal=true and keep them in a separate index so they do not pollute production aggregates. Also return confidence bands for cost estimates (eg ±10%).
mina: UX asks: show inline delta chips for cost and latency and a tiny "what changed" summary. If candidate_model is provided, show a side-by-side comparison. Mobile defaults to sample_pct=1.
rick: Ops: add per-user rate-limits (default 8/min) and per-org throttles. Cache identical rehearsal requests for 45s to avoid repeated runs from UI fiddling. Return X-RateLimit headers so Console can display usage.
sophie: Security: rehearsals must not leak lists of routes or their policies. If user lacks access to a route, return 403 with a CTA to request owner approval. For route owners we can show model percentages but not internal fallback reasons. Also require an audit log entry whenever a rehearsal touches org-level scope.
devon: Implementation: include header X-RW-REHEARSE: true and X-RW-REHEARSE-ID in responses. Frontdoor will inject X-RW-SYNTHETIC for telemetry to identify these runs. Cache key = sha256(query+scope+window+sample_pct+candidate_model+user).
mina: Ownership: devon (API), han (telemetry), sophie (security), rick (UX). Timeline proposal: 3d spike (API + mock), 4d infra proto, 2d UX polish. Gate behind feature flag.
audit-bot: audit: rehearsal-request recorded, id=reh_98765, created-by=mina
mina: tiny nit: show "~1200 tokens ±12%" confidence in UI. Also ensure mobile uses smallest sample by default.
rick: OK let's prototype. :thumbsup:
sophie: +1
devon: starting spike now.
